response.justification: Despite extensive software engineering experience, the candidate lacks junior-level alignment: they are a senior with 10+ years of experience, overqualified and misaligned with an entry-level role; they have only basic German proficiency, failing the mandatory language requirement; and their primary tech stack is TypeScript/Node.js/DLang, with Java listed as a minor skill without demonstrable project depth in insurance or agile contexts.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience across multiple languages and domains
Strong open-source contributions and technical teaching background
Proven track record in agile practices and CI/CD infrastructure
concerns: Overqualified senior with no indication of seeking entry-level role
German proficiency is only basic, not sufficient for client-facing consulting
Java experience is minimal and not central to their portfolio
